title: Black Dragon Coleus - 1x Plug Plant - Interesting Coleus Outdoor/Indoor
description: The Black Dragon Coleus is a stunning outdoor plant that thrives in temperate climates, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments. This clumping plant features striking black foliage, adding a unique touch to any garden or patio. With a palmate leaf form and vegetative growth habit, this Coleus from the Solenostemon genus is perfect for autumn planting. Easy to care for with medium watering needs, this plug plant comes with soil included, making it a convenient addition to your houseplants collection.
